Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Class FreehandTool

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.AbstractTool
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.FreehandTool
All Implemented Interfaces:
Tool
Direct Known Subclasses:
BrushTool, EraserTool, PencilTool, SprayTool
public abstract class FreehandTool extends AbstractTool
Shared behaviour of the freehand tools (brush, pencil, eraser, spray). A press snapshots the active layer for undo and paints a dot; each drag paints the segment from the previous point to the new one straight into the layer and asks the canvas to repaint so the stroke appears live; the release paints the final segment and commits one per-layer undo edit for the whole stroke.

Subclasses only supply drawSegment(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.geom.Point2D, java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) (and optionally drawDot(java.awt.Graphics2D, java.awt.geom.Point2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) / decorate(java.awt.Graphics2D, org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintContext) to tweak the graphics, e.g. the eraser switching to AlphaComposite.CLEAR).
